params.prompt: Compose: the stone Tejaji shrine from the FIRST reference image (same shrine, same horseman-and-cobra idol, same oil lamp) standing on the left of frame at night at a village fair in 1990 — the shrine has only a FEW red threads tied on it, the stone cleaner and less worn — and beside it, right of frame in profile facing the shrine, the MAN from the second reference and the WOMAN from the third reference performing this gesture: his bare wrist held out, she tying a red sacred thread onto it. They are TEN YEARS YOUNGER than the references — he is 35, jet-black hair, thin strong build, wearing a simple white cotton kurta; she is 30, in a deep-blue cotton sari with pallu over her head, gold nathni, red bindi, glass bangles — and a SMALL GIRL of about five holds the hem of her sari, half-hiding, watching the ritual. Behind them: a 1990 village fair — kerosene pressure lanterns on stalls, a small hand-cranked iron ferris wheel silhouetted, men in dhotis, no electric string lights, firelight tones. Rendered as a 1990 COLOR FILM PRINT: heavy film grain, faded warm Kodachrome colors with slight color shift, soft focus edges, the look of a photograph that has sat in an album for thirty years. No text anywhere.
